metadata.title: Fusion 360 CAM Complete Parameter Catalog
metadata.description: Exhaustive enumeration of Fusion 360 Manufacturing workspace parameters, toolpath types, and Python API surface

adaptive_clearing_3d.description: High-efficiency 3D roughing with constant tool engagement. Maintains consistent chip load through complex geometry by dynamically adjusting toolpath.

params.name: rest_machining
params.description: Enable rest machining from previous operation

params.name: optimal_load_percentage
params.description: Optimal load as percentage of tool diameter

params.name: use_flat_area_detection
params.description: Detect and machine flat areas separately

params.name: stay_down_angle
params.description: Max ramp angle while staying down

pocket_clearing_3d.description: Traditional pocket clearing with parallel or spiral patterns. Variable engagement, suitable for shallow pockets.

parallel.description: 3D parallel finishing with constant stepover. Creates uniform cusp patterns on freeform surfaces.

params.name: cusp_height
params.description: Target cusp height for scallop mode

contour.description: Z-level constant-Z finishing for steep walls. Creates horizontal scallop marks.

params.name: continuous_spiral
params.description: Use continuous spiral instead of loops

scallop.description: Constant scallop height finishing that adapts stepover to maintain consistent surface roughness.

pencil.description: Corner and fillet finishing that traces internal corners. Removes rest material in tight areas.

radial.description: Radial passes emanating from center point. Ideal for circular or radially symmetric features.

spiral.description: Continuous spiral finishing pattern for smooth surface finish with no step marks.

morphed_spiral.description: Spiral toolpath morphing between boundary curves. Excellent for blended surfaces.

steep_and_shallow.description: Automatic combination of parallel and Z-level based on surface angle. Threshold-based strategy switching.

params.name: threshold_angle
params.description: Angle to switch between steep and shallow strategies

params.name: continuous_spiral
params.description: Use continuous spiral for steep areas

params.name: overlap_distance
params.description: Overlap between steep and shallow regions

horizontal.description: Machine only horizontal or near-horizontal surfaces. Useful for flat bottoms and ledges.

ramp.description: Create continuous ramp or helix patterns. Used for specialized finishing.

swarf.description: Flank milling using full flute length on ruled surfaces. Maximum productivity for straight-sided features.

params.name: tool
params.description: Typically flat or bull nose endmill

params.name: drive_surface
params.description: Ruled surface to machine with tool flank

multi_axis_contour.description: 5-axis point milling with lead/lag/tilt control. Maximum flexibility for complex freeform surfaces.

params.name: minimum_tilt
params.description: Min tilt from vertical to avoid singularity

flow.description: 5-axis UV flowline finishing that follows surface natural flow. Ideal for organic shapes.

morphed_spiral_multiaxis.description: Multi-axis morphed spiral between boundary curves with 5-axis tool orientation.

rotary_4axis.description: 4-axis simultaneous or indexed rotary machining around cylindrical or conical parts.

trimming.description: 5-axis edge trimming for composite and sheet materials.

impeller_machining.description: Specialized 5-axis toolpath for impeller and blisk machining with blade-specific parameters.

turning_profile_roughing.description: OD/ID profile roughing with multiple passes.

turning_profile_finishing.description: Single-pass profile finishing for OD/ID features.

probe_geometry.description: Measure part features for process control and tool compensation.

params.name: search_distance
params.description: Max distance to search for contact

surface_inspection.description: Probe freeform surface against CAD model.

part_alignment.description: Probe part features to establish WCS or validate fixture position.

fusion360_python_api.description: Fusion 360 CAM Python API namespace for programmatic CAM operations

methods.name: postProcess
methods.description: Post process operations to NC code

create_operation.description: Pattern for creating a CAM operation programmatically
create_operation.code_example:
cam = adsk.cam.CAM.cast(app.activeProduct)
setup = cam.setups.item(0)
operations = setup.operations

# Create adaptive clearing
input = operations.createInput('adaptive')
input.tool = toolLibrary.item(0)
input.parameters.itemByName('tolerance').expression = '0.01 mm'
input.parameters.itemByName('optimalLoad').expression = '5 mm'

op = operations.add(input)

generate_toolpath.code_example:
cam = adsk.cam.CAM.cast(app.activeProduct)
future = cam.generateAllToolpaths(False)

# Wait for completion
while not future.isGenerationCompleted:
    adsk.doEvents()

print(f'Generated {future.numberOfOpsCompleted} toolpaths')

post_process.description: Pattern for post processing to G-code
post_process.code_example:
cam = adsk.cam.CAM.cast(app.activeProduct)
postInput = adsk.cam.PostProcessInput.create()
postInput.postConfiguration = 'C:/Posts/haas.cps'
postInput.outputFolder = 'C:/NCOutput'
postInput.programName = 'PART001'
cam.postProcessAll(postInput)
